character: weary female agama, sandy-orange hide, backwards cap, thick striped tail, exactly four legs, fills two thirds of frame
props: three fat toads - their place is her back, flanks and tail until 6.9, gripping on with all four hands, never the ground; a 399 board by the trail, only digits; a motorcycle by the trail, leather jacket and smoked-visor helmet on the bar, suitcase on the rack
motion_rule: every window she covers ground - charging the lens, galloping across it or wheeling round - never standing to speak, never a plain walk; she wrenches, kicks and shakes the toads off, they grab straight back; camera moves with her; new shot size every window
environment: clay trail running at the lens, hard midday sun; background under a third

audio.delivery: weary female voice, native Russian stress
audio.pronunciation: stress: sbra-SY-va-yu, KHVOST, tya-zhe-LO, sbra-SY-va-ye-te, TSE-ny, ras-TUT
audio.pacing: brisk, no drawling; nothing said after 6.9
audio.lip_sync: mouth moves on every syllable, never a voice-over
audio.sfx: pounding claws, croaks, dry pop as the tail tears, board slam, engine roar, paper flutter

timeline.a: bursts out of the depth at the lens, dust wall behind
keeps coming at the lens, rams her shoulder back into the toad on her spine
gallops the trail, boots back at the toad on her tail | all three swing off her flanks
drives at the lens throwing dirt, shakes her whole body | a toad climbs to her cap, shrugged down her back
hurls her whole body round into the lens | a toad swings past the lens on her neck
wheels a full turn on her body and charges back the other way | all three whip out sideways, dust wall
rams the 399 board with her shoulder at full run | rips the top toad off and hurls it past the lens
plants both claws, her thick tail tears off at the base with a dry pop, all three still on it | the loose tail whips round and slams the board flat
timeline.c: big low, tail base and board

timeline.a: freed, she springs to the bike, rips jacket and helmet off the bar | the three thrash on the severed tail
into the jacket, jams the helmet, snaps the visor, stump twitching | a toad leaps at her, she boots it away
swings a leg over, stamps the starter, rear wheel spinning a wall of dust over the three
the bike leaps into the depth over the flattened board, suitcase springs, banknotes streaming behind
the three stampede at the lens through the dust snatching notes, growing huge, colliding over the lens | the severed tail whips across frame

must_appear: toad hurled past the lens at 5.2; tail off with all three on it by 6.9; board slammed flat at 6.9; notes fly at 8.8; toads charge the lens at 9.4
negative_prompt: night, dark scene, subtitles, watermark, cyrillic, letters on the 399 board, same shot size twice, she stands still while speaking, a toad on the ground before 6.9, a gap between her and the toads before 6.9, a window where the toads do nothing, a wide shot with her small in frame before 6.9, the tail as a plug from a pit, the severed tail gone from frame, the toads sitting still at the end, extra limbs, a fifth leg, deformed anatomy, character changing mid-shot, English speech, any word after 6.9
